name: Zul'Gurub: Bloodlord Mandokir sentences a gazed player who casts a heal costing mana on the GCD
contract: The Menacing Gaze (2118423) tooltip: 'any active hostile action will force his hand. Active actions are all
spell and ability casts that require a power source and are on the global cooldown.' Renew (139) costs
17 % base mana and triggers the 1.5 s GCD, so under the gaze it Sentences the caster to Die (2118424). The
round 6 script skipped positive spells and casts whose paid cost was 0, which let heals, buffs and
Clearcasting casts through (tester, round 7: 'sometimes no Decapitate'). Mandokir gazes his only enemy 15 s
into the fight and turns it into Menacing Gaze 4 s later; the hero stands in melee and does not attack.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is in Zul'Gurub on Normal
CONTROL: Mandokir stares at the hero with Threatening Gaze 15 s into the fight
CONTROL: 4 s later the stare turns into Menacing Gaze
CONTROL: the gaze alone does not sentence the hero
The gazed hero casts Renew on the hero
DISCRIMINATING: a heal that requires mana and triggers the GCD Sentences the hero to Die
CONTROL: the sentence consumed the Menacing Gaze
